<thought>Using the available functional group names, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, break the functional groups “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds”. These correspond to the groups that are lost in the described cycloaddition. I will also include that a C‑O bond is broken (represented by “carboxylic esters”) and a new C‑C bond is formed (a generic “C‑C double bonds” change can capture the formation of a sigma bond). This should return templates that match the described transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
